cases.title: Create a team space
steps: Start the app and create user A as TESTING.md describes
POST /rpc/spaces/createTeam as A with {"json":{"name":"Payments team"}}
POST /rpc/spaces/list as A
cases.expected: createTeam returns a spaceId; spaces.list includes the personal space and a space named "Payments team" with kind "team" and role "owner"; in the web UI the Create menu shows New team space and the new space appears in the sidebar

cases.title: Invite and accept
steps: As A, POST /rpc/spaces/invites/create with the team spaceId and the email of a new user B
GET /api/dev/emails and find the message to B containing an /invite/<token> link
Create user B with that email as TESTING.md describes
POST /rpc/spaces/invites/accept as B with {"json":{"token":"<token>"}}
POST /rpc/spaces/members/list as A with the team spaceId
cases.expected: accept returns the team spaceId; members.list shows A as owner and B as member and no pending invite for B; accepting the same token again returns 404

cases.title: Member uses a teammate's bot and thread
steps: As A with header x-rakazo-space-id set to the team space, create a bot (bots/create) and send it a message
As B with the same space header, call bots/list, open the bot's thread messages, and send a follow-up message
cases.expected: B's bots.list includes A's bot; B can read A's message in the thread; B's message is recorded in the same thread and a run is created for it

cases.title: Non-member gets nothing
steps: Create user C as TESTING.md describes
As C, POST /rpc/bots/list with header x-rakazo-space-id set to the team space id
As C, POST /rpc/spaces/members/list with the team spaceId
cases.expected: bots/list with the team space header returns 401; members/list returns 404; C's spaces.list does not include the team space

cases.title: Requester-only approval
steps: In the team space, have B start a run on the shared bot that pauses on an approval card (for example a tool that always asks, as the approval tests in the repo do)
As A, answer the approval with threads/answer
As B, answer the same approval
cases.expected: The approval card has waitingOn of kind member naming B; A's answer is refused (409) and the card is read-only for A in the UI; B's answer is accepted

cases.title: Unattended approval shows its origin
steps: As A, rotate the shared bot's webhook secret (bots/rotateWebhookSecret) and POST a JSON event to the returned path with that secret
Wait for the run to pause on an approval, then read the thread as B
As B, answer the approval
cases.expected: The run's approval card has waitingOn of kind any and a trigger with kind webhook; B (who did not start the run) can approve it

cases.title: Removing a member revokes access and keeps their work
steps: As B in the team space, create a routine on the shared bot
As A, POST /rpc/spaces/members/remove with the team spaceId and B's userId
As B, POST /rpc/bots/list with the team space header
As A, list routines in the team space
cases.expected: remove returns {}; B gets 401 for the team space; B's routine still exists and is now owned by A

cases.title: Last owner cannot leave
steps: With A as the only owner and B a member, POST /rpc/spaces/leave as A with the team spaceId
cases.expected: Response is 400 and A is still an owner in members.list; after A makes B an owner (members/setRole), A can leave and gets back their personal space id

cases.title: Private spaces are unchanged
steps: As a new user D, use the personal space: create a bot, send a message, create a private space from the Create menu, rename and delete it
cases.expected: All steps behave as before; spaces.list shows kind private for D's spaces; no Members section appears in private space settings

cases.title: Shared threads show who sent each message
steps: In the team space, A and B each send a message in the shared bot's thread
Open the thread in the web app as A
cases.expected: The messages page returns sender with B's userId and name on B's message; the web thread shows B's name and avatar above B's message and A's own messages look as before
